quotes.text: Very fun and laid back. Enjoyed very much. Loved the dogs
quotes.author: Extra Email

quotes.text: I had the most incredible week at Sion Surf! I was on a 5 month travel trip around the world at the time and this was without a doubt one of my favourite weeks. I was a beginner surfer and the surf instructors were brilliant, patient and kind. The food, hosts and staff are all amazing. So much fun,  I can't wait to go back!!!
quotes.author: Amy

quotes.text: Great place to surf. Nice accommodation. Friendly staff. Great surf Instructors. Yoga classes. Entertaining live music on Fridays. Really enjoyed my week spent there.
quotes.author: Yasheen Sewnarain

quotes.text: Food is good and the spot is nice on seaside.  Service is ok, some guys are super cool and some guys are very ordinary but overall it's nice.  Place is usually occupied by surfers.  Chill place!  We went many times, especially for breakfast.
quotes.author: Olivier Grau
